name: consumer-app
title: Consumer app
description: Email, Google or wallet sign-in, an embedded wallet, and a real PEPU send - Next.js + Privy + wagmi
recommendedFor: Your first PEPU app: login, wallet, send.

name: token-gated-app
title: Token-gated app
description: Sign in, then unlock content by holding an ERC-20 or NFT - balance checks batched via Multicall3
extraSteps: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_GATE_ERC20_ADDRESS and/or NEXT_PUBLIC_GATE_ERC721_ADDRESS in .env.local to the token that unlocks your content (at least one is required).

name: nft-mint
title: NFT mint
description: An ERC-721 mint page (connect, mint, view owned tokens) plus the Foundry + Hardhat contract
extraSteps: Deploy the ERC-721 contract in contracts/ (Foundry or Hardhat, see its README) and set NEXT_PUBLIC_NFT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS to the deployed address.
recommendedFor: A mint page for your own collection.

name: game-app
title: Game app
description: A tap-to-score game demoing Privy session signers - grant once, then play with no wallet popup per move
extraSteps: Run {run:generate-authorization-key} to create a P-256 authorization key pair. Register the public key as a key quorum in the Privy dashboard, then set NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_KEY_QUORUM_ID (the quorum id) and PRIVY_AUTHORIZATION_KEY (the private key; server only, never commit it).
Deploy the TapScore contract in contracts/ (Foundry or Hardhat) and set NEXT_PUBLIC_GAME_CONTRACT_ADDRESS.
recommendedFor: Games and apps that need many fast, popup-free actions.

name: sponsored-demo
title: Sponsored demo
description: Gas-sponsored transactions: a zero-balance smart account taps on-chain, paid by the PEPU paymaster (uses the hosted bundler; the paymaster needs your project's token)
extraSteps: In the Privy dashboard enable Smart Wallets: chain 97741, provider Kernel, bundler URL https://bundler.pepeunchained.com and paymaster URL https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/paymaster/<your project token> (claim, deposit and register a project first; see README).
recommendedFor: Gasless transactions through the PEPU paymaster.

name: sponsored-session-app
title: Sponsored session app
description: Google or email sign-in, one scoped on-chain session, then actions with no popup and no user gas: ZeroDev Kernel session key plus the PEPU paymaster (needs a bundler + paymaster; PEPU's are not public yet)
extraSteps: Set PEPU_BUNDLER_URL (default https://bundler.pepeunchained.com) and PEPU_PAYMASTER_URL (https://paymaster.pepeunchained.com/v2/paymaster/<your project server key>; server only, it embeds a secret). Get a project first: claim, deposit, set limits, register (see README).
recommendedFor: The full stack: Google or email sign-in, session keys and sponsored gas.
